outcome: Accuracy of ultrasound in diagnosing head flexion
cohort: Pregnant women with abnormal labor due to prolonged labor, abnormal cardiotocography, and OP rotation who underwent intrapartum sonography
finding: Intrapartum ultrasound is more accurate than digital examination in differentiating OP rotation with normal flexion from deflexion, and fetuses with deflexed presentations in this context were never delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: Fetuses with abnormal labor and OP rotation had deflexed presentations in 14% of cases and were never delivered vaginally.
